posts.title: Midnight at a 7-Eleven
posts.description: Five years in Canada, counted from the night I walked out of quarantine into an empty street and a closed McDonald's.

posts.title: A mote of dust
posts.description: Reading Carl Sagan while the world feels like it's moving away from light and into darkness. A reflection on ignorance, power, and our responsibility to the pale blue dot.

posts.title: First post
posts.description: I've been planning to start a blog for years. This post is unfinished and kind of uninspired, but I'd rather post it than nothing at all. For the past few years, I've been using an app called mymind to share my thoughts. (I'll keep using it; I can't say enough about how much I like it.) It organizes all my links, lists, articles, and notes. I love how simple it is. Clean, useful, and the developer
